content.text: Jaylen Waddle Denver Broncos, Wide Receiver Age: 27y-4m-1d (Nov 25, 1998) Exp: 5 Years Country: US College: Alabama Drafted: Round 1 (#6 overall), 2021 Agent(s): Joel Segal (WME Sports) Contract Details Career Earnings Injuries Transactions Statistics Career Earnings $58,715,175 2024-2028 Rookie Extension (CURRENT) In his first offseason of extension eligibility, Jaylen Waddle signed a 3 year, $84.75M extension with the Miami Dolphins that keeps him under contract through 2028 at a total value of $104.6M. The deal includes $76M practically guaranteed, with $36M of that fully guaranteed at signing, including an $18.8M signing bonus. Early vesting mechanisms are built into his 2026 & 2027 salaries, making this a 4 year, $77.3M contract for practical purposes.
